what: v4 fit evaluation protocol, frozen before any fit data is built; the pools are eval/fit_freeze.json

systems.rule: Each candidate model (g = SFT with reasoning traces, h = SFT without, i = DPO if it runs, d3 as the reference) is scored as a system: the eligibility layer (src/matcher/hybrid.py H' on the Adaption-extracted card, salary cap included) decides Skip where it fires, the model decides every other row.
systems.eligibility_layer: src/matcher/hybrid.py H' on the Adaption-extracted card, salary cap included

selection.rule: On data/built/fit/dev_fit.jsonl only. Pick the system with the highest macro-F1; if two are within 0.01, prefer the one without reasoning traces (cheaper to serve). The fresh test plays no part in selection.
selection.tie_break: prefer the system without reasoning traces

fresh_test.rule: Scored once, for every system and these baselines on the same rows: skills-free rules (rules on the extracted card with must and nice skills removed), full rules on the extracted card, the untrained Qwen3.5-4B with the eligibility layer, and d3 + H'. Gold is data/built/fresh_test/gold.jsonl: two independent blind labelers, disagreements adjudicated blind to cards, rules and models.
baselines: skills-free rules (rules on the extracted card with must and nice skills removed)
full rules on the extracted card
the untrained Qwen3.5-4B with the eligibility layer
fresh_test.gold_process: two independent blind labelers, disagreements adjudicated blind to cards, rules and models
fresh_test.pool: data/built/fit/pools/test.jsonl (sha256 in eval/fit_freeze.json); the test builder samples 150

headline.rule: Accuracy and macro-F1 of the chosen system against skills-free rules, as a paired difference with 95% intervals from a bootstrap that resamples postings and candidates. Reported on all rows and on the eligibility-pass slice (rows the eligibility layer lets through, which are the rows that need the resume). Labeler agreement (raw and Cohen's kappa) is reported as the ceiling.
slices: eligibility-pass slice (rows the eligibility layer lets through)

pass.rule: The chosen system beats skills-free rules on the eligibility-pass slice with the interval above zero. Whatever the result, it is reported as it is.
